description: Successor to us-rulespec-2026-11-11-cms-w6-federal-guidance on rulespec-us's corpus pin line, whose newest cut that selector is. This selector keeps 282 of its 284 scopes and adds 149 signed scopes that us-rulespec-2026-10-13-w7-bundle-gaps-union already selects and the pin line never did. They carry the source text of 347 Tier 1 documents of the SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP and UI program bundles that the encoder cannot read through the pin, including 80 U.S. Code sections in titles 8, 25, 26, 29, 38 and 42. Two added scopes are consolidated successors that hold every citation path of the base scope each one replaces: us-co/statute/2026-07-19-rulespec-us-co-title-39-consolidated and us-wa/regulation/2026-06-25-388-450-r2026-07-15-self-contained. Every other scope of the base stays, including the pin's three withdrawn ME, MI and MN 2026-07-13 recovery scopes; manifests/withdrawn-scopes.yaml records an exception for this selector on each. It ingests nothing. Publish it only as a pin release for rulespec-us; do not activate it.
name: us-rulespec-2026-11-24-tier1-source-text
